test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 2: USER ACCOUNT RECOVERY SCENARIO
test_cases.test_case_title: Verify Email for Password Recovery - Teacher Account
test_cases.pre_condition: The system is online and able to process authentication requests. A user (Teacher) has a registered account with email 'GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com'. The user is on the Landing Page and the Login modal is open with the 'Forgot Password?' link displayed.
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays a form requesting the user to enter their registered email address for password recovery. Upon entering a valid email, the system validates it, sends a password recovery link, and notifies the user to check their inbox.
test_cases.post_condition: A password recovery email has been sent to 'GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com', and the user is notified on-screen to check their inbox. The system is ready to process the password reset.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Forgot Password?' link on the Login Modal.
Click the 'Submit' button for email verification.
